experiments.title: Test first quarter
experiments.instruction: Predict 25%, 50%, or 75% illuminated at 90°. Keep the Sun direction and Earth viewpoint fixed, then observe first quarter.
experiments.observe: Half of the visible disk is lit at 90°. Explain the distinction between half the visible disk and half the whole Moon always receiving sunlight.

experiments.title: Compare opposite quarters
experiments.instruction: Predict whether first quarter at 90° or last quarter at 270° has a larger visible lit fraction. Compare them from the same Earth viewpoint.
experiments.observe: Both are 50% lit, on opposite sides. Explain why equal fractions can have different phase names without Earth casting a shadow.
